newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate flat on stable peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate flat on stable peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were unchanged at 20.00 percent in early trade on Tuesday due to what traders said was a stable peso in the wake of U.S. inflation data.

"(U.S.) inflation data were mild and more or less in line with expectations and dollars are not in excessive demand," a trader said, referring to U.S. consumer price figures, released shortly before dealing opened.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts were 0.5 of centavo firmer at 7.9510/7.9540 per dollar.
Overnight rates on bank paper were meanwhile up 30 basis points at 20.65 percent.
"There is no pressure, no peso weakness ansd the secondary market is calm," another trader said.
Liquidity of 150 million pesos was due to return to the system from prior central bank operations.
